title: Agent Bricks
subtitle: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent
promise: Build agents over documents, then orchestrate specialists.
description: Knowledge Assistant for document Q&A and Supervisor Agent for multi-agent orchestration. Picks up where the Genie Agents course stops at 'what happened' and moves toward 'why'.
notes: Scope to Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent only — Information Extraction and Custom LLM are marked legacy in the docs, so do not build curriculum on them. Cover Supervisor Agent's long-running task mode and the Supervisor API (Beta). Reuse the Meridian dataset and its document volume.
